headerDisplay: Pulse-Eight USB-CEC Universal Apple TV Bridge for Homebridge
footerDisplay: Captures Apple TV HDMI-CEC button presses and power state via cec-client (libcec), exposing native HomeKit switches/sensors and optionally dispatching actions to any Trinnov, TCP/Telnet AVR, or HTTP webhook target.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name for this platform instance in Homebridge.

_bridge.title: Child Bridge
_bridge.description: Optional Homebridge Child Bridge settings (managed via Bridge Settings in Homebridge UI).

cecClientPath.title: cec-client Executable Path
cecClientPath.description: Path to the libcec cec-client binary (e.g. 'cec-client', '/opt/homebrew/bin/cec-client', or '/usr/bin/cec-client').

portPath.title: Pulse-Eight Serial Port (Optional)
portPath.description: Leave blank to let cec-client auto-detect the Pulse-Eight adapter, or specify an explicit serial device path.

osdName.title: CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Device name advertised on the HDMI-CEC bus (up to 14 characters).

hdmiPort.title: HDMI Port Number (Optional)
hdmiPort.description: Optional HDMI port number (-p) if cec-client needs an explicit port for your receiver/switch.

holdMode.title: Volume Hold Behavior (HomeKit Switches)

oneOf.title: Continuous Repeat (Emit Single Press every 150ms while held)

holdMode.description: How holding Volume Up or Volume Down on the Siri Remote maps to HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch events. Direct target commands always step continuously while held.

holdDelayMs.title: Hold Threshold Delay (ms)
holdDelayMs.description: Milliseconds a volume button must be held before triggering Long Press or starting repeat ticks.

holdRepeatMs.title: Hold Repeat Interval (ms)
holdRepeatMs.description: Repeat interval in milliseconds while Volume Up or Volume Down is held.

holdSafetyMs.title: Hold Safety Timeout (ms)
holdSafetyMs.description: Maximum duration before automatically stopping a hold if a CEC release packet (0x45) is dropped.

rescanIntervalSec.title: Periodic CEC Bus Rescan Interval (seconds)
rescanIntervalSec.description: Optional interval to periodically re-scan the HDMI-CEC bus for newly connected Apple TVs (0 = only scan on startup and unknown device traffic).

powerSensorType.title: HomeKit Power / Activity Service

oneOf.title: Occupancy Sensor (Recommended for Apple Home Automations)

powerSensorType.description: Optionally expose an OccupancySensor or Switch per Apple TV driven by CEC Active Source (0x82) / Image View On (0x04) and Standby (0x36).

includePowerButtons.title: Expose Power On / Power Off Programmable Buttons
includePowerButtons.description: Adds stateless Power On and Power Off buttons to each Apple TV accessory in HomeKit.

powerKeyMode.title: Remote Power Key Handling (0x44:40 / 6b / 6c / 6d)

oneOf.title: Handle Remote Power Keys (Emit Power Actions & HomeKit Events)

powerKeyMode.description: Choose whether to ignore CEC remote power button frames or handle them with the configured power debounce and target rules.

powerDebounceMs.title: Power State Flicker Debounce (ms)
powerDebounceMs.description: Settle window in milliseconds to filter rapid on/off CEC power flicker.

ignoreStandbyAfterWakeMs.title: Ignore Standby Immediately After Wake (ms)
ignoreStandbyAfterWakeMs.description: Optional guard window (in ms) to ignore spurious CEC Standby (0x36) frames arriving immediately after an Apple TV wakes (0 = disabled).

targetMode.title: Action Target Driver Mode

oneOf.title: Auto (Auto-discover Homebridge plugins or use configured host)

targetMode.description: Select how captured CEC actions are dispatched. HomeKit accessories remain active in all modes.

targetHost.title: Target IP / Hostname (Optional)
targetHost.description: IP address or hostname of the target AVR, processor, or HTTP bridge. Leave blank to auto-discover via Homebridge discovery files or config.json.

targetPort.title: Target TCP / HTTP Port (Optional)
targetPort.description: Port of the target device (defaults: 44100 for Trinnov, 23 for TCP, 80 for HTTP).

targetVolumeStepDb.title: Target Volume Step (dB / Unit)
targetVolumeStepDb.description: Step value interpolated into {{stepDb}} for each tap or repeat tick (default: 1).

targetMuteAction.title: Target Mute Action
targetMuteAction.description: Whether Mute presses are forwarded to the configured target driver.

targetPowerMode.title: Target Power Command Routing

oneOf.title: Remote Power Keys Only (when powerKeyMode is Handle)
Never Send Power Commands to Target

targetPowerMode.description: Controls when powerOn / powerOff actions are forwarded to the target driver.

targetDiscoveryUrl.title: Target HTTP Discovery URL (Optional)
targetDiscoveryUrl.description: Optional HTTP endpoint returning homebridge-cec-targets / discovery JSON when running across containers or hosts.

targetClientId.title: Target TCP Client ID (Optional)
targetClientId.description: Client identifier interpolated as {{clientId}} during TCP init handshakes (e.g. Trinnov 'id <clientId>').

targetIdleTimeoutMs.title: Target TCP Idle Disconnect Timeout (ms)
targetIdleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before sending optional 'bye' and closing the TCP socket (default: 60000; 0 = keep connected).

targetAutodetectPlugins.title: Additional Homebridge Plugin Names to Autodetect (Optional)
targetAutodetectPlugins.description: Optional extra platform/accessory names or keywords to scan in Homebridge config.json alongside built-in AVR/TV presets.

tcpCommands.title: Generic TCP Command Templates (for targetMode = 'tcp' or custom overrides)
tcpCommands.description: Command templates sent over TCP. Supports {{stepDb}}, {{-stepDb}}, {{clientId}}, {{source}}, escaped \r / \n, and 'hex:...' binary frames.

httpEndpoints.title: HTTP Webhook Endpoints (for targetMode = 'http')
httpEndpoints.description: HTTP endpoint definitions (URL string or { url, method, headers, body }) for each semantic action.

devices.title: Apple TV Filters & Target Overrides (Optional)
devices.description: By default, all Apple TVs found by 'cec-client scan' are exposed automatically. Add entries here to filter specific Apple TVs, customize their HomeKit names, or override their target driver/host.

logicalAddress.title: CEC Logical Address (Hex)
logicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by CEC logical address nibble (e.g. '4' for Playback 1, '8' for Playback 2, 'b' for Playback 3).

physicalAddress.title: CEC Physical Address
physicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by HDMI physical address (e.g. '6.0.0.0').

osdName.title: Discovered CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Match discovered Apple TV by its CEC OSD string.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to false to ignore this Apple TV.

targetEnabled.title: Enable Direct Target Control for this Apple TV
targetEnabled.description: Set to false to prevent this Apple TV's remote from sending direct commands to external targets.

trinnovId.title: [Legacy Alias] Target Trinnov Processor ID / Name
